description: Turns the knobs and faders of an Akai APC40 into CV, on a fixed controller map with no learning and no remapping

params.text: Scales that output from -1 through zero to +1, so a fully anticlockwise setting gives 0 to -10V and the centre holds the output at 0V

outputs.text: One of the eight track controls, its own controller number on MIDI channel 1 mapped onto 0 to 10V before the attenuverter above it
One of the eight device controls, its own controller number on MIDI channel 1 mapped onto 0 to 10V before the attenuverter above it
The cue level control, controller 47 on MIDI channel 1, mapped onto 0 to 10V before its attenuverter
The master control, controller 14 on MIDI channel 1, mapped onto 0 to 10V before its attenuverter
The crossfader, controller 11 on MIDI channel 1, mapped onto 0 to 10V before its attenuverter
One of the eight channel faders, controller 7 on its own MIDI channel, mapped straight onto 0 to 10V with no attenuverter in the way

notes: choose the hardware's MIDI port in the module's menu; MIDI reception is forced to Omni because the eight faders share one controller number across eight channels.
only control change messages are read, and nothing is sent back to the hardware, so motorised faders and knob rings are not updated.
an attenuverter multiplies rather than offsets, so at any setting a controller value of zero comes out as 0V.
